summary: BidBlitz Store Submission Package - Frontend Testing Complete. All public store pages (/privacy, /terms, /support, /contact, /delete-account) render correctly and are accessible. Store-safe mode (STORE_SAFE_MODE=true) correctly blocks gambling/auction modules. Support page navigation to all public pages works. Delete account path is visible in MorePage -> Settings -> Privacy -> Delete Account. Landing footer links present and functional.

issues: Minor HTML nesting warning: button cannot contain nested button (Toggle component inside MenuRow) - cosmetic only, does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: All public store pages have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Store-safe blocking is correctly implemented via isStoreBlockedPath() and STORE_BLOCKED_PATHS set
Delete account flow is accessible via MorePage -> APP -> Settings -> Privacy -> Delete Account button
Landing footer has all required public links (privacy, terms, contact)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Store submission public pages are fully functional. All routes tested: /privacy, /terms, /contact, /delete-account, /support. Store-safe mode blocks: /auctions, /live-auctions, /arcade, /spin-wheel, /reward-plinko, /lottery. Delete account accessible via MorePage -> APP section -> Einstellungen -> Datenschutz-Einstellungen -> Mein Konto löschen button.
working_features: /privacy - Privacy Policy page renders with full content
/terms - Terms page renders with full content
/contact - Contact page renders with all 3 contact channels (support, privacy, security)
/delete-account - Delete Account page renders with 4 steps and official channels
/support - Support page renders with links to privacy, terms, contact, delete-account
Landing page footer links present (privacy, terms, contact)
Footer privacy link navigates to /privacy correctly
MorePage -> APP -> Settings -> Privacy -> Delete Account navigation works
No blank pages on any public routes
test_scope: BidBlitz Store Submission Package - Apple App Store and Google Play public pages verification
